name: seed_gift_store_credit_cashout_observe
author_notes: Observe only. Cannot leave Observe or auto-Promote. First-party instrument_kind on refund/payout. Fail-closed when the field is absent. Not production loss-prevention evidence.

rules.description: Refund cashed out to a gift card or store credit: a reversible card payment is returned as a bearer instrument that is hard to claw back. Observe only.
Payout issued as a gift card or store credit instead of the original tender. Observe only.
